description: VAS (Value-Added Services) Module — replaces legacy bagging_work_order/bagging_progress with a generalised BOM-driven BAGGING/DE_BAGGING/RE_BAGGING workflow. Adds 6 new ops-schema tables, 3 new ENUMs, 3 CQRS feature groups (Bom/WorkOrders/Sessions), and 3 new frontend feature modules.

backendStructure.migrationNotes: DROP ops.bagging_work_order, DROP ops.bagging_progress, DROP ENUM bagging_status. CREATE vas_type/vas_work_order_status/vas_session_status ENUMs. CREATE 6 new ops tables. ReferenceType on invent_trans is varchar(50) — no migration needed for VAS value.

keyBusinessRules.BR-VAS-001: Enforce in CreateVasBom + ToggleVasBomStatus: check existing active BOM for (tenant_id, service_type, target_item_id)
keyBusinessRules.BR-VAS-002: Enforce in ToggleVasBomStatus: block deactivation if WO with status IN (CONFIRMED, IN_PROGRESS) exists for this bom_id
keyBusinessRules.BR-VAS-003: Enforce in ConfirmVasWorkOrder: check on_hand available_qty >= planned_qty per lot; skip CLIENT_OWNED packaging
keyBusinessRules.BR-VAS-004: Enforce in ConfirmVasSession: output_qty > 0, target_location_id set, all lines have consumed_qty > 0 and source_location_id
keyBusinessRules.BR-VAS-005: In ConfirmVasSession: if BOM line packaging_ownership == TvlOwned → create ISSUE trans; if ClientOwned → skip ISSUE trans entirely
keyBusinessRules.BR-VAS-006: In ConfirmVasSession: if service_type == DE_BAGGING → skip RECEIPT trans
keyBusinessRules.BR-VAS-007: In CompleteVasWorkOrder: COUNT(sessions WHERE status='OPEN') must be 0
keyBusinessRules.BR-VAS-008: In CompleteVasWorkOrder: call IBillingCaptureService.CaptureBaggingFeeAsync; catch NotFoundException, log warning, continue
keyBusinessRules.BR-VAS-009: In ConfirmVasSession: throw if session.Status != OPEN
keyBusinessRules.BR-VAS-010: In ConfirmVasSession: per session_line, check available_qty of source_lot >= consumed_qty using direct invent_trans query

inventTransPattern.atomicity: All trans in ConfirmVasSession must be inside a single EF SaveChangesAsync. Use IDbContextTransaction if IInventTransService calls separate SaveChangesAsync internally.

lotCreationPattern.sourceLotId: primary source lot = non-packaging VasWorkOrderSource with highest planned_qty

screens: BOM Create/Edit form with BOM lines grid

lookupPatterns.itemLookup: GET /api/items/lookup → { id (UUID PK), code, name } → use item.id as value
lookupPatterns.ownerLookup: GET /api/owners/lookup → { id (UUID PK), code, name } → use owner.id as value
lookupPatterns.warehouseLookup: GET /api/warehouses/lookup → { id (UUID PK), code, name } → use warehouse.id as value
lookupPatterns.lotLookup: GET /api/lots/lookup → { id (UUID PK), code, name } → use lot.id as value
lookupPatterns.locationLookup: GET /api/locations/lookup → { loc (natural string PK), code, name } → use location.loc (code) as value
lookupPatterns.note: Location has natural string PK — use loc/code, not id. All others use UUID id.

featureSchema.description: Zod schemas for VAS Work Order
featureSchema.code:
import { z } from 'zod'

export const vasWorkOrderSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string().uuid(),
  vwoNumber: z.string(),
  serviceType: z.enum(['BAGGING', 'DE_BAGGING', 'RE_BAGGING']),
  bomId: z.string().uuid(),
  bomName: z.string().optional(),
  ownerId: z.string().uuid(),
  ownerName: z.string().optional(),
  warehouseId: z.string().uuid(),
  warehouseName: z.string().optional(),
  targetItemId: z.string().uuid(),
  targetItemName: z.string().optional(),
  targetLotId: z.string().uuid().nullable().optional(),
  plannedQty: z.number(),
  actualQty: z.number(),
  status: z.enum(['DRAFT', 'CONFIRMED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED']),
  notes: z.string().nullable().optional(),
  createdTime: z.string().optional(),
  createdBy: z.string().optional(),
})

export type VasWorkOrderDto = z.infer<typeof vasWorkOrderSchema>

export const confirmSessionSchema = z.object({
  outputQty: z.number().positive('Output quantity must be greater than 0'),
  targetLocationId: z.string().uuid('Target location is required'),
  lines: z.array(z.object({
    vwoSourceId: z.string().uuid(),
    sourceItemId: z.string().uuid(),
    sourceLotId: z.string().uuid(),
    sourceLocationId: z.string().uuid('Source location is required'),
    consumedQty: z.number().positive('Consumed quantity must be greater than 0'),
  })).min(1, 'At least one material line is required'),
})

export type ConfirmSessionFormValues = z.infer<typeof confirmSessionSchema>
